messages:
sarah: Quick Q — trying to investigate a GPU SM% spike last night on prod-dedicated. Does anyone know where to pull historical KV-cache hit rate + avg batch_size per model? Need to correlate with SM% uptick. Dashboards/queries appreciated.

devin: There's a grafana dashboard called 'GPU Utilization' under eng-runtime > gpu that has SM% panels and a server-level KV hitrate panel. Link: https://grafana.redwood/g/abc123/gpu-utilization . Heads up it's server-level, not per-model.

kai: @sarah for per-model KV stats we do export `redwood_kv_cache_hit_ratio{model="<model>"}` and batching metrics `redwood_infer_batch_size_avg`. Example query for hit ratio (30m window):
```
(sum by (model) (rate(redwood_kv_cache_hits[30m]))) / (sum by (model) (rate(redwood_kv_cache_requests[30m])))
```
That will give you per-model hit ratio at 30m resolution.

sarah: Nice, thanks. Do we have retention for those metrics? Need 7 days of 1m-resolution to look at last week.

marta: Retention for those prod metrics is 14d at 1m, traces are shorter (3d). If you need longer or full traces we can do a backfill/export. Also FYI the KV hitrate alert currently fires when ratio < 0.6 for 5m — might be noisy for short spikes. @devin can confirm.

devin: We set that threshold a while back to catch sustained regressions. If this was a 30m blip it could be spamming. Paste the exact timestamps and I'll check alert history/incident logs.

sarah: Root window: 2026-03-15 03:10 UTC -> 03:40 UTC. I'll try the queries. Also any quick way to overlay SM% and miss rate in one panel to visually check correlation?

kai: Try an overlay like this (rough):
```
avg_over_time(redwood_gpu_sm_utilization[30m]) by (model) ,
avg_over_time(redwood_kv_cache_miss_rate[30m]) by (model)
```
or compute a simple ratio: `avg_over_time(redwood_gpu_sm_utilization[30m]) by (model) / avg_over_time(redwood_kv_cache_miss_rate[30m]) by (model)` — not perfect but shows correlation. Also check `redwood_model_batch_size_p95` to see sudden batch-size drops/increases.

oliver: If you need historical 1m per-model beyond retention we can run a backfill from object store, but that requires an eng-sre ticket (`#backfill`) and a short ops window.

sarah: Copy — I'll run the queries and paste screenshots. If I can't get per-model prod KV data I'll open a backfill ticket. Thanks all :pray:

runtime-bot: Note: grafana link above may require SSO; if anyone can't access it ping #devex and we'll share a temp link.
